subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: What scoped performance investigation should OpenClaw accept for this native Linux VPS slowness report?
rationale: The central missing work is not one proven code defect; maintainers need to choose the measurement environment, workload, signals, and acceptance criteria before automation can safely act.

options.title: Publish runbook and split gaps
options.body: Create a bounded runbook from current telemetry and docs, then open narrow follow-ups only for measured missing spans or hot-path fixes.

options.title: Limit to existing event-loop trackers
options.body: Treat this issue as an umbrella and redirect only the gateway event-loop portions to narrower open issues and PRs.

options.title: Sponsor full live profiling
options.body: Run a CPX32-like live profiling project before writing docs or filing code-level follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Publish runbook and split gaps
recommendation.body: Create a bounded runbook from current telemetry and docs, then open narrow follow-ups only for measured missing spans or hot-path fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current docs and runtime-adjacent history point to steipete as the best available owner for deciding the runbook scope.
